system.description:
See Figurine of Wondrous Power

This silver statuette of a raven can become a Raven for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.

Foundry Note

This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.

notes: not automated (summon): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
summon: its creature is not among the converted creatures
not automated (save): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
effect: "Carrying Message" (its own changes) not converted
